articles.titleZh: 马斯克糟糕的一周：特斯拉自2022年以来遭受最严重下滑，SpaceX在星舰测试飞行前下跌
articles.text: Shares in Tesla and SpaceX declined this week with Elon Musk's automaker suffering its worst slump since 2022. SpaceX dropped about 7% for the week ahead of a planned test flight of its massive Starship V3 rocket on Friday.
articles.textZh: 特斯拉和SpaceX的股票本周下跌，埃隆·马斯克的汽车制造商自2022年以来遭受最严重的下滑。SpaceX在计划于周五进行的其大型星舰V3火箭测试飞行前下跌了约7%。
